title: [MCP] Provide environment and company descriptions to the platform
summary: Environment Information Impl. and Company Information Mgt. now subscribe to two new platform events, GetEnvironmentDescription and GetCompanyDescription, to supply the environment and company descriptions. The MCP server's list_companies tool can then return company descriptions. This requires the platform change that adds the events.
key_points: Subscribes to the platform events GetEnvironmentDescription and GetCompanyDescription on System Action Triggers; the events come from a separate platform change
Environment Information Impl. returns the environment description
Company Information Mgt. (W1, NA, ES) reads the requested company's description using ChangeCompany, so the session's company stays the same
An empty description is returned when the company is missing, not accessible or has no Company Information record
The MCP list_companies tool uses the company description so agents can tell companies apart
quote: The platform's MCP server returns the company description from its `list_companies` tool, so agents can tell companies apart.
